design: 50 fixed openings from openings-50.json, color-swapped pairs, one subprocess per pair, 6 in parallel. Hybrid: depth-2 weak engine + selector=jev, top-3 within 30 units. Opponent: plain depth-2 weak engine. Deterministic engines; Jev adds API time.
